svg.title: Step dispatch paths and outcome protocol
svg.desc: _executeStep branches by step type. Bash, approval, aggregate-reviews and foreach-nested loop steps run on the host without a task. An agent step writes the task triple, runs its work turns and an optional finalizer turn on one leased worker, extracts and validates outputs, then resolves a semantic outcome that the failure policies turn into a run effect.

g.text: Hover a box for its invariants and file; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Step dispatch paths and outcome protocol
Only agent steps create tasks. Every path ends in a StepOutcome that the node loop merges, holds on or fails on.

g.class: e join f-exec t-bash t-approval t-aggregate t-nested
e join f-st5 t-ok t-fail t-input

g.text: _executeStep · step_dispatcher.dart branches on the step type: bash, approval, aggregate-reviews, loop, otherwise agent
Every path returns a StepOutcome that the node loop merges, holds on or fails on.
bash · bash_step_runner.dart: /bin/sh -c with a sanitized environment; stdout and stderr each capped at 64 KB
A non-zero or unstartable exit is an execution error governed by onError, never an empty success.
approval · approval_step_runner.dart persists the hold, then fires WorkflowApprovalRequestedEvent; resume starts at the next step
Under approvals auto the gate approves itself with no pending state.
aggregate-reviews · aggregate_step_runner.dart merges review reports and sums counts from context values
No task and no tokens; the result source is context values.
loop · a loop-type step is reachable only as a foreach child; the loop runs against the per-iteration context
Dispatched without a nested-loop scope, it fails the run.
Task triple · workflow_task_factory.dart writes the three rows in one transaction; Task.maxRetries is 0
Only onFailure: retry with maxRetries N (N+1 attempts) retries a workflow task, so it cannot multiply with the task runtime's retry.
prompt chain on one leased worker;
Work turn(s) · WorkflowOneShotRunner holds one worker lease for the whole prompt chain; the step budget is checked before each prompt
Each turn's token reading is written to the step receipt before the next prompt; a failed receipt write stops the chain.
no work tools, at most 4 turns, one re-ask;
Finalizer turn · runs when the step has model-derived outputs or a format: path claim; the prompt carries the full persisted JSON schema
A missing or malformed envelope gets one re-ask, then fails validation and enters the retry path.
Extract + validate · context_extractor.dart: host-owned source:, path and inline resolvers; the envelope is the only model-derived source
Path validation runs after finalization: a claimed succeeded cannot bypass a missing required artifact.
Resolve outcome · envelope step_outcome first; then the <step-outcome> tag, parsed only for emitsOwnOutcome steps; then task status
Terminal failed or rejected forces failed, cancelled forces cancelled; an accepted task with no outcome resolves to succeeded with a warning.
execution error · task creation or wait failure, non-zero or unstartable bash, or a hard failure before any outcome
fail ends the run, pause holds it at the failed unit (paused), continue advances with a failed step record.
succeeded · outputs merge into context and the walk continues
The step's work is promoted when it is the last branch-touching step in scope.
failed · a failed outcome, validation failures included: fail ends the run, continue records it and advances
retry allows N+1 attempts and stops early on two equal failures; pause moves the run to awaitingApproval at the step.
needsInput · by default the run moves to awaitingApproval; onFailure: continue records the reason and advances
Approvals auto-on-stall or auto approve it, record _approval.auto_resolved.<stepId> and fire WorkflowApprovalResolvedEvent.
cancelled · a task cancelled while the run is running is an interruption, not a failure; only the engine assigns cancelled
The run pauses without advancing currentStepIndex, resume re-runs the step, and no git cleanup runs.
